title: Aurelia
blurb: A members' concierge: floating-label fields, a gliding tab bar, gold sweeps in on button hover.

title: Noctis
blurb: A late-night workspace: sign-in/sign-up ride a sliding pill toggle, particles drift behind a glass card.

title: Verdant
blurb: A textile atelier: plain-text mode switch, static labels (no floating), a flat solid button — no slider, no wipe.

title: The Bordeaux Press
blurb: A literary subscription desk: sign-in and sign-up sit on either side of a real 3D page turn.

title: Copper & Oak
blurb: A boutique workshop: boxed inputs with static labels, a pill toggle, and a button that presses down with a hard offset shadow.

title: The Vault
blurb: Private holdings: a small dot marker slides along a dial track instead of a bar; a mechanical dial rotates in on load.

title: Ambergris & Co.
blurb: A perfumery: the button fills upward like liquid on hover, tying back to the vial that fills on load.

title: Marbleworks Studio
blurb: An architecture studio: the card opens along a horizontal seam; static labels, plain-text mode switch, solid button.

title: Hour & Co.
blurb: A watchmaker: a fine gold hand sweeps continuously behind the panel; the button fills via a circle expanding from its center.

title: Ink & Linen Co.
blurb: A letterpress stationer: the header stamps into focus on load; static labels, plain-text mode switch, solid button.

title: Solstice Club
blurb: A private club: the button blooms with a soft glow on hover instead of filling; sun-rays rotate slowly behind the emblem.

title: Cellar No. 9
blurb: A wine cellar: the button carries a continuous slow flicker, like it's lit from within, echoing the candlelight glow behind the card.

title: Meridian Exchange
blurb: A private exchange's verification step: auto-advancing digit boxes, full paste support, and a resend timer that actually counts down.

title: The Keep
blurb: The screen a returning user sees far more than a real login: your name and avatar are known, only the password is missing.

title: Fielding & Co.
blurb: No password to type or leak: one email field, one link sent, and a real confirmation state with a resend option.
